home.title: A Fullstack Developer
home.goal: I build web apps, tools and self-hosted projects, and I'm always looking for the next thing to learn.

about.p1: I'm a student at KTH Royal Institute of Technology in Stockholm, studying Information and Communication Technology. I've been programming for years and enjoy working across the whole stack, from frontend design to backend logic and the servers everything runs on.
about.p2: I have experience with a range of languages and frameworks, including Python, JavaScript, React, Next.js and PHP, and I'm currently learning lower-level programming in C, Rust and RISC-V assembly.
about.p3: Outside of school I like working on my own projects: building websites, tinkering with hardware, and running things on my own home server, including this site.
about.p4: I'm always eager to learn new technologies and take on new challenges. Feel free to look through my projects below or get in touch.
